This is the server-internal actor ID; Arena.perspective(team).units correctly masks enemies as appearance_* while disguise/clone is live, yet top-level room payload discloses private id.
defect.source_location: multiplayer/room_v453_dev47.mjs publicInfo(p) around room source offset 2400, same method as GET /api/session, SSE room view and room create/join response
defect.suggested_rust_fix: project public reaction identity through authoritative per-seat alias resolver; masked enemies receive their current valid appearance_* public target reference if observable, else null/opaque unavailable. Keep server-internal enemyId private, authorize client target by server-revalidated alias, never allow user-supplied stable id to bypass owner/fog.
defect.qualification: The test deliberately staged a decision using the real pauseForDecision API; it did not demonstrate ordinary combat producing this exact masked reaction or a live HTTP response. Classify as confirmed code-path privacy leak, not a measured network attack.
defect.distinct_from_s17: S17 retroactive past event text + stable actor id disclosure. S18 leaks the current attacker stable ID in PvP room pendingDecision top-level metadata even while Arena.perspective protects the alias.
